identity_rules: issuer receives a dedicated dispatch-ledger login, never a custody or service-role credential
writer and worker persistence credentials must equal their already isolated R69 credentials
operator uses a human session and no machine database credential
credentials cannot be generic, duplicated or embedded as values
function sets are exact and cannot be widened
proved_locally: the R69 topology fingerprint binds the overlay
exact persistence functions are compiled per principal
generic service credentials and cross-principal reuse are rejected
writer and worker identity drift from R69 is rejected
canonical authority fingerprint is independent of grant ordering
bounded_claim: R72 proves a content-free persistence-authority overlay. It does not create roles, users, grants, tables, sessions or migrations.
next_gate: Implement R70 dispatch and R71 event persistence behind functions matching this exact authority overlay, then prove replay and transition locks in local PostgreSQL.
